en: A reason why something happens; or to make something happen.
ex: Heavy rain was the cause of the flood.
大雨是造成水災的原因。

en: In the middle of a place; or main and most important.
ex: The hotel is in a central part of the city.
這家飯店位於市中心。

en: A period of one hundred years.
ex: The old church was built in the sixteenth century.
這座老教堂建於十六世紀。

en: A series of metal rings joined together; or a group of shops or hotels owned by one company; or to fasten with a chain.
ex: She wore a gold chain around her neck.
她脖子上戴著一條金項鍊。

en: A soft white stick used for writing on a blackboard; or a soft white rock.
ex: The teacher wrote on the blackboard with chalk.
老師用粉筆在黑板上寫字。

en: Something that is difficult to do and tests your ability; or to invite someone to compete; or to question something.
ex: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
學習一種新語言是很大的挑戰。

en: A TV or radio station; or a narrow area of water joining two seas; or a way through which information passes.
ex: Let's change the channel; this show is boring.
我們換台吧，這節目很無聊。

en: One of the parts into which a book is divided, usually with a number or title.
ex: I have read the first three chapters of the book.
我已讀完這本書的前三章。

en: The qualities that make a person different; or a person in a story or film; or a letter or symbol in writing.
ex: The main character in the film is a young doctor.
電影的主角是一位年輕的醫生。

en: The amount of money you must pay for something; or a formal accusation of a crime; or to ask for money; or to attack.
ex: There is no charge for children under five.
五歲以下兒童免費。

en: A drawing that shows information with lines or pictures; or a map of the sea or the sky; or to record information.
ex: The chart shows how many students joined each club.
這張圖表顯示每個社團有多少學生參加。

en: To run after someone or something to catch them; or the act of doing this.
ex: The dog chased the cat across the garden.
狗追著貓跑過花園。

en: To act dishonestly to get an advantage; or to copy answers in an exam; or a person who does this.
ex: He was caught cheating in the math exam.
他在數學考試中作弊被抓到。

en: To shout loudly to show support or happiness; or a loud shout of joy; or to make someone feel happier.
ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored a goal.
隊伍進球時，群眾歡呼起來。

en: A substance used in or made by chemistry; or relating to chemistry.
ex: The factory uses chemicals to make plastic.
這間工廠使用化學藥品製造塑膠。

en: A board game for two players who move pieces of different shapes across a board of black and white squares.
ex: My grandfather taught me how to play chess.
我祖父教我怎麼下西洋棋。

en: A person in charge of a group; or the most important; or main.
ex: The chief of the village welcomed the visitors.
村長歡迎訪客。

en: Behaving like a child, in a silly way; or of or like a child.
ex: It is childish to cry over such a small thing.
為這麼小的事哭很幼稚。

en: Two thin sticks used to eat food, especially in East Asia.
ex: She is learning to eat with chopsticks.
她正在學習用筷子吃飯。

en: To say that something is true without proof; or to ask for something that belongs to you; or a statement.
ex: He claimed that he had never seen the man before.
他聲稱以前從未見過那個男人。

en: To hit your hands together to show you like something; or to hit something lightly; or a sudden loud noise.
ex: The audience clapped after the song ended.
歌曲結束後觀眾鼓掌。

en: A book, film or piece of music that is of high quality and has lasted for a long time; or typical or traditional.
ex: This novel is a classic of English literature.
這部小說是英國文學的經典。

en: Relating to the culture of ancient Greece and Rome; or relating to traditional European music; or of high quality and lasting value.
ex: She enjoys listening to classical music before bed.
她喜歡在睡前聽古典音樂。

en: A person who is in the same class at school or college as you.
ex: I did my homework with a classmate.
我和一位同學一起做功課。

en: Quick to learn and understand things; or skillful at doing something; or showing good planning.
ex: She is a clever girl who learns very quickly.
她是個學得很快的聰明女孩。

en: To press a button on a computer mouse; or a short, sharp sound; or to make this sound.
ex: Click on the icon to open the program.
點擊圖示開啟程式。

en: The usual weather conditions in a place over a long period; or the general situation of a society.
ex: The climate in Taiwan is warm and wet.
台灣的氣候溫暖潮濕。

en: Material made by weaving cotton, wool or silk; or a piece of this material used for cleaning.
ex: She wiped the table with a clean cloth.
她用乾淨的布擦桌子。

en: The things that people wear on their bodies, such as shirts, pants and dresses.
ex: Please wear warm clothing in the winter.
冬天請穿保暖的衣物。

en: Covered with clouds; or not clear, as with a liquid.
ex: It is cloudy today, so it might rain later.
今天多雲，晚點可能會下雨。

en: A large, dark brown insect that lives in dirty places in houses and comes out at night.
ex: She screamed when she saw a cockroach in the kitchen.
她看到廚房裡有蟑螂時尖叫起來。

en: A brown powder made from cocoa beans, used to make chocolate; or a hot drink made from it.
ex: We drank hot cocoa to keep warm in the cold night.
我們喝熱可可在寒夜裡取暖。

en: A sweet, brown fizzy drink; or a brand of this drink.
ex: He ordered a hamburger and a cola.
他點了一個漢堡和一杯可樂。

en: A place where students study for a degree after school; or a part of a university.
ex: She plans to go to college to study art.
她打算上大學學藝術。

en: A flat piece of plastic or metal with teeth, used to tidy hair; or the red flesh on top of a chicken's head; or to search carefully.
ex: He combed his hair before going out.
他出門前梳了頭髮。

en: To put two or more things together to form one; or to join together.
ex: Combine the flour and sugar in a large bowl.
把麵粉和糖放在一個大碗裡混合。

en: To order someone to do something; or the power to control a situation; or an instruction on a computer.
ex: The captain commanded the soldiers to stop.
隊長命令士兵們停下來。

en: Relating to business and the buying and selling of goods; or a TV or radio advertisement.
ex: The shop is in a busy commercial area.
這家店位於繁忙的商業區。

en: An organization that makes or sells goods or services; or having other people with you; or a group of people.
ex: Her father works for a large company.
她父親在一家大公司工作。

en: To look at two or more things to see how they are different or similar; or to say one thing is like another.
ex: Let's compare the prices of the two phones.
我們來比較一下這兩支手機的價格。
